title:
Explore the code-forge codebase to understand the current flow for:
1. Command preview - when and how command previews are shown
2. Approval system - how approvals work for tool calls (especially inline code changes)
3. Pager usage - where external pagers like `less` are used and how they work
4. The Enter / q key handling flow for approve/quit

Search for:
- Files related to "approval", "approve", "confirm", "preview"
- Files related to "pager", "less", "page"
- Files related to "command" display/preview
- Files related to "inline" code changes
- Key handling patterns for Enter/q

Look in crates/, commands/, and the main source directory. Provide file paths with line numbers for all relevant code sections.
